svg.title: ReTake: how it works
svg.desc: Animated diagram: a skate line is recorded, the skater bails, a moment is picked on the timeline, inputs replay to that moment at 4x, a 3-2-1 countdown hands control back, and the best attempts play back as one run.

g.text: Skate the line. Every input is recorded.
Bail. Open the timeline and pick a moment.
Your inputs replay up to that moment at 4×.
3, 2, 1, and the controls are yours again.
Land it. The new attempt replaces the rest.
Play every best attempt back as one run.
